description: INSEE (published on the Région Réunion open data portal) publishes the geolocated Permanent Facilities Database (BPE) of INSEE for La Réunion, built each year from administrative sources and split into seven domains: services to individuals, shops, education, health, transport and travel, sports, leisure and culture, and tourism; fields include the equipment code and name, category, geocoding quality, establishment name, canteen, boarding, covered, lit and capacity. Coverage: the island of La Réunion (French overseas department); edition 2021 with about 23,900 records, record last modified on 2022-10-27. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of the Région Réunion. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open License v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: from the 2021 edition the SIRUS register replaces SIRENE and excludes statistically ceased units, so counts fall against earlier editions; a snapshot of one year. Simulation uses: service and facility locations for accessibility, evacuation and hazard-exposure analyses of an island territory. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: La Réunion: Permanent Facilities Database 2021 (BPE, geolocated)
